description: This Java class 'UpDownImage' is a custom Swing JPanel component that visualizes engine report data, including signal waveforms, revolutions, and timing information, for a logical analyzer in a vehicle engine tuning application.

classes.name: UpDownImage
classes.description: A Swing JPanel component that renders engine signal waveforms, revolution data, and timing information for a logical analyzer display.

methods.name: UpDownImage
methods.description: Constructor initializing with engine report and signal name, setting up mouse listeners and tooltips.

methods.name: setSignalBody
methods.description: Sets the color used for the signal body in the visualization.

methods.name: setSignalBorder
methods.description: Sets the color used for the signal border in the visualization.

methods.name: setToolTip
methods.description: Sets a two-line tooltip with channel and physical pin information.

methods.name: setZoomProvider
methods.description: Placeholder for setting zoom provider, currently empty.

methods.name: setTranslator
methods.description: Sets a custom TimeAxisTranslator for coordinate conversions.

methods.name: createTranslator
methods.description: Creates a default TimeAxisTranslator based on the engine report.

methods.name: setWaveReport
methods.description: Updates the engine report and revolutions data, triggers repaint.

methods.name: propagateDwellIntoSensor
methods.description: Updates sensor value with the latest signal dwell duration.

methods.name: paint
methods.description: Custom rendering of signal waveforms, scale lines, and revolution markers.

methods.name: drawStartOfRevolution
methods.description: Draws vertical lines indicating revolution start points, optionally labels TDC.

methods.name: isShowTdcLabel
methods.description: Determines whether to show TDC labels; default false.

methods.name: paintScaleLines
methods.description: Draws vertical scale lines at millisecond intervals.

methods.name: paintUpDown
methods.description: Draws individual signal segments with timing and angle annotations.

methods.name: setPhysicalPin
methods.description: Sets the physical pin label and updates tooltip.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
